summary: The authors reported two discoveries for 16-hour hypothalamic HFD versus chow. The public sources searched contained neither gene identities nor per-gene statistics. The registered analysis had zero FDR discoveries and retained one HFD library the authors excluded after PCA. Gene-level agreement remains unassessed. The proposal passed validation, and all 75 downloaded files passed checksum verification. [Paper](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10771486/) · [Author archive](https://zenodo.org/records/10116113)
openIssues: A gene-level comparison requires the authors’ original run-0010 hypothalamus HFD-versus-chow DESeq2 table with Ensembl IDs, log2 fold changes, P values and adjusted P values.
